HENDERSON, Nev., Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Research Solutions, Inc. (

) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by KnowledgeWorks Global Ltd., a CJK Group company. Under the terms of the agreement, Research Solutions stockholders will receive $3.25 per share in cash, representing a premium of approximately 52% over the closing price on November 20th, 2026.

KnowledgeWorks Global Ltd. (KGL) provides editorial, peer review, production, hosting, and related services to publishers. Research Solutions builds tools for researchers and research organizations, including Scite and Article Galaxy. The two companies address distinct parts of the same research workflow, and their combination will expand the capabilities available to publishers and researchers.

"This transaction delivers immediate value to our stockholders at a significant premium, and it gives Research Solutions the right home for what we have built. Scite and Article Galaxy sit between publishers and the researchers who rely on their content, including inside the AI tools they increasingly use. KGL supports publishers from manuscripts through publication. Together, we cover more of the content lifecycle than either company could alone. I want to thank our stockholders for their support as we reached this milestone," said Roy W. Olivier, President and Chief Executive Officer of Research Solutions.

"Our publisher clients stake their reputations on delivering the latest research, and the ways in which it gets discovered and used continue to change. Combining KGL's publishing services expertise with Research Solutions technology creates new opportunities to help publishers extend the reach and impact of their content. We see a strong fit between our businesses and are glad to welcome the Research Solutions team to CJK," said Chris Kurtzman, President and Chief Executive Officer of CJK Group, Inc.
Transaction Details

The Research Solutions Board of Directors unanimously approved the transaction. The transaction is subject to approval by Research Solutions stockholders and other customary closing conditions. It is expected to close in the first calendar quarter of 2027. Upon closing, Research Solutions common stock will no longer trade on the Nasdaq.

TD Securities is serving as exclusive financial advisor to Research Solutions, and Godfrey & Kahn is serving as legal counsel. Honigman LLP is serving as legal counsel to KnowledgeWorks Global Ltd. and CJK Group, Inc., and RSM US LLP is serving as accounting advisor.
About Research Solutions
Research Solutions, Inc. (

) is a holding company providing software and AI solutions for enterprise R&D teams and academic institutions. Through proprietary data, integrated workflows, and access infrastructure, the Company gives modern researchers and their AI systems the infrastructure to find, trust, and act on scientific research faster.

About KnowledgeWorks Global Ltd.

KnowledgeWorks Global Ltd. (KGL) is the premier industry provider of editorial, peer review, production, online hosting, institutional sales, author marketing, consulting, and transformative solutions for every stage of the content lifecycle. KGL serves the STEM/HSS, educational publishing, and eLearning markets from content creation through digital and print publication. Part of the CJK Group, KGL unites content and technology expertise with over 200 years of experience serving the publishing market. For more information, please visit www.kwglobal.com.
About CJK Group, Inc.

Headquartered in Brainerd, MN, CJK Group, Inc. is an international portfolio of market-leading companies providing printing, publishing services, technology and information solutions, and logistics services. Its operating companies include Continuum, KnowledgeWorks Global Ltd., Sheridan, Tweddle Group, and WLX|WLE. www.cjkgroup.com

Information regarding the interests of these directors and executive officers in the transaction described herein will be included in the proxy statement described above. Additional information regarding directors and executive officers of Research Solutions is also included in the Company's definitive proxy statement for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, which was filed with the SEC on October 1, 2026. These documents are available free of charge as described above.
